# DataMatrix

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A native, high-performance, vector-based Data Matrix (ECC200) element.

Implements a full ISO/IEC 16022 compliant encoder with automatic encodation (ASCII, C40, Text, X12, EDIFACT, Base-256) and interleaved Reed-Solomon error correction. Like `QRCode`, it draws sharp vector rectangles rather than a bitmap, so the symbol stays crisp at any zoom and adds almost nothing to the PDF size, coalescing adjacent modules into the smallest possible payload.

Data Matrix is a high-density 2D symbology favoured for small marks - parts, labels, documents - and unlike QR it supports rectangular as well as square symbols.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IAltTextProvider`, `IRoleProvider`.

### `AltText`

```csharp
string AltText { get; set; }
```

Alternate text description for accessibility. When the document opts into `AccessibilityMode.PdfUa1`, this populates the `/Alt` entry on the structure element wrapping the symbol.

### `BackgroundColor`

```csharp
Color BackgroundColor { get; set; }
```

The background colour (usually white, recommended for reliable scanning).

### `Data`

```csharp
string Data { get; set; }
```

The data/text to encode. Any string is accepted; characters outside Latin-1 are encoded as their UTF-8 bytes.

### `DrawBackground`

```csharp
bool DrawBackground { get; set; }
```

Whether to draw the background. If `false`, the symbol is transparent.

### `ForegroundColor`

```csharp
Color ForegroundColor { get; set; }
```

The colour of the dark modules (usually black).

### `Gs1`

```csharp
bool Gs1 { get; set; }
```

Encodes the GS1 start and field separators.

### `IsDecorative`

```csharp
bool IsDecorative { get; set; }
```

When `true`, the symbol is purely decorative and is tagged as `/Artifact` with no alt-text warning.

### `QuietZone`

```csharp
int QuietZone { get; set; }
```

Number of quiet-zone modules around the symbol. The spec requires at least 1. Default 2.

### `Rectangular`

```csharp
bool Rectangular { get; set; }
```

Request a rectangular symbol for short messages where one is available. Defaults to `false` (square symbols).

### `SemanticRole`

```csharp
SemanticRole SemanticRole { get; }
```

*read-only*

The structure role in a tagged PDF: `Figure` when the element has alternative text, otherwise `Artifact`. It is always `Artifact` when `IsDecorative` is set.

### `Size`

```csharp
float Size { get; set; }
```

The display width of the symbol in points (the quiet zone is included). For square symbols the height equals the width; for rectangular symbols the height is derived from the symbol's aspect ratio.
